description: Benchmark regression budgets (issue #58). Percent thresholds are relative to the base value; absolute thresholds are in the metric's own unit. Metrics without an entry are reported ungated (warning-only) until calibrated. Changes to this file are reviewed like code: accepting a regression intentionally requires editing it. Issue #180: routing.route_decision.p95_us is gated in absolute microseconds, not percent, because its base value is single-digit microseconds — a percent budget there is smaller than one timer tick of run-to-run noise. Its min_samples floor is set above one 3-event fixture pass, so the gate only decides this metric from repeated runs (benchmarks/budgets.json evidence in docs/benchmark-gate.adoc).
